existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 Immunization has material breaking changes despite stable canonical identity. Top concerns are CodeableReference remodels, removal of `recorded`/`education`, and new invariants on `statusReason` and `subpotentReason`. Main uncertainty is terminology and official rationale because expansions and narrative change notes were not available.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be treated as a real transform, not a package-version swap. Update parsers and generated models for renamed/reshaped fields; define policy for removed fields (`recorded`, `education`); add validation prechecks for new invariants; and design R6-to-R4 extension or loss-reporting rules for R6-only fields and widened targets.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for StructureDefinition deltas because both local core StructureDefinitions were present and compared directly. Confidence is medium for terminology impact and design rationale because full terminology expansions, official diffs, narrative pages, and ConceptMaps were not available. Base-artifact changes were intentionally excluded by scope.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Immunization keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 10 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 7 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 100/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

10 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.
